description: This file defines the interface SavingsAccountChargeReadPlatformService, which provides methods to retrieve various savings account charge data and templates within the Fineract project.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargeReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for reading savings account charge and fee data from the platform.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountChargeTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for savings account charges.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountCharges
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of charges for a specific savings account, filtered by status.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountChargeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific savings account charge.

methods.name: retrieveChargesWithAnnualFeeDue
methods.description: Retrieves charges that have an associated annual fee that is due.

methods.name: retrieveChargesWithDue
methods.description: Retrieves charges with fees that are currently due.
